name: Deutschlandstipendium
provider: Deutschlandstipendium (Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt, with the universities and private sponsors)

summary.fr: Bourse au mérite de 300 € par mois (150 € de l'État fédéral, 150 € de parrains privés), attribuée par les universités qui participent au programme.
summary.en: Merit scholarship of EUR 300 a month (EUR 150 from the federal government, EUR 150 from private sponsors), awarded by the universities that take part.

howToApply.fr: Candidatez directement auprès de votre université, selon ses critères, ses pièces et ses dates.
howToApply.en: Apply directly to your university, following its criteria, documents and dates.

eligibility.quote: First- and higher-semester students of all nationalities can apply directly to their university
financial and non-material support to high-achieving and committed students from all over the world

level.quote: The Deutschlandstipendium supports highly talented students at all participating universities in Germany.
First- and higher-semester students of all nationalities can apply directly to their university
Grundsätzlich ist jedes Studium an einer staatlichen oder staatlich anerkannten Hochschule förderungsfähig.

support.quote: 300 euros per month for international top-class talent

howToApply.quote: The Deutschlandstipendium is awarded by the universities. Applicants must meet the requirements of the individual institutions.
